role: The SwiftUI App declaration: takes the root services (sync, settings, StoreKit, language, voice chat, Watch bridge, email bridge) from AppDependencies.current and builds the collector as @State, assembles the root view (MainTabView + environment + launch modals + scene-phase handlers + interrupted-session alerts + launch tasks), wires Watch->phone control closures, and holds the @main entry EmuquMain.
types: LaunchModal: enum — which full-screen launch cover is up (disclaimer/onboarding/paywall/trialReminder/scoreArchitectureChange)
InterruptedSessionInfo: struct — a recording found persisted at launch; isResumable gates the resume alert
EmuquApp: struct (App) — app root; extended by AppLaunchTasks.swift and AppLaunchRecovery.swift
EmuquMain: enum (@main) — process entry, runs UI-test wipe + crash handlers before EmuquApp.main()
state: mem:coldStartLog (file-private OSLog subsystem com.chrissharp.flowrecovery category ColdStart)
mem:EmuquApp.launchServices (let, AppDependencies.current.launchServices: the resolvers AppLaunchTasks.swift uses)
mem:EmuquApp.returningFromBackground (@State private Bool: set on .background, cleared on the next .active)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers of EmuquApp pass each root object through launchStep (a ColdStart signpost plus NSLog/debugLog start and done lines): the collector from RRCollector.makeDefault(), the other seven from AppDependencies.current accessors (collection.sessionReanalysis, storage.cloudKitSyncManager, app.settingsManager, services.storeKitManager, services.languageManager, assistant.voiceConversationController, services.watchConnectivityBridge). emailBridge reads AppDependencies.current.assistant.assistantEmailBridge directly, and launchServices takes AppDependencies.current.launchServices, which builds resolvers only (no service is built until the launch work calls one). All of them run when EmuquApp.main() instantiates the App struct, after EmuquMain.main() has run the UI-test wipe and diagnostics install; AppDependencies.current is a lock-held container that exists from first access and that has no setter and that the app never replaces (only a test's AppDependencies.install puts another in force), so a test that installs its own container before building EmuquApp has its substitutes used. The file reads no `.shared` singleton (scripts/check_no_shared_outside_root.sh does not list it as a root). LaunchModal conforms to Identifiable for fullScreenCover(item:) and, having no associated values, is Equatable and drives .onChange(of: activeModal).

units.does: Scene-phase reactions: background -> marks returningFromBackground, auto-archives the pending session and stops ambient location; any non-active->active -> start ambient location; on active also reschedule morning notification, refresh HealthKit write auth if onboarded, and, on the first active after a background (background → inactive → active), resumeAfterBackground (sync and entitlement re-check).

branches.effect: true: returningFromBackground = true, autoArchivePendingSession() and AmbientLocationService.stop(); false: skip
returns early (no reschedule/HK/sync/entitlement work for inactive/background)
true: resumeAfterBackground(); false: skip (an inactive->active without a background neither syncs nor re-checks)

On foreground, starts ambient location updates only if onboarding is complete and the AI assistant is enabled, and only when permission is already granted (startIfAuthorized never prompts).

On background, if the collector has a completed session awaiting acceptance, begins a BackgroundTaskAssertion and starts an unstructured Task that runs collector.acceptSession() (archive + baseline) and ends the assertion when it returns or throws (deferred); errors are logged only. If the background budget runs out first the assertion's expiration handler ends it, so iOS suspends the app instead of killing it.

branches.effect: returns; true: begins the assertion and launches acceptance Task
error only debugLogged; session stays pending in memory; assertion still ended by the defer
